rationale: Task asks for each code's share of denials summing to one, so the ranking base is denied claims (scope=denied_claims), not all claims. Missing-code quantification must cover overall, among denied, and by claim status (quantify_missing=by_status); the manifest shows denial_code_carc null on 11559 of 12845 rows, so the split by status is needed to separate expected nulls on paid claims from true gaps on denied ones. Denial rates are requested across all five named segments, restricted to claims whose adjudication has concluded (denominator=adjudicated_claims), with segments under 30 claims flagged unstable (min_group_size=30). The report prints every rate as numerator/denominator, cites artifacts for every number, and states the synthetic-data and small-group caveats the task requires; descriptive_only and association_not_causation are added because segment rate differences are observational comparisons, not causal effects. No skills were provided in this baseline condition.
